sections.title: What to look for in workshop booking software.
sections.lead: Check these eight things, whichever tool you choose. {{brand.name}} does all of them.

items.title: Paid booking
items.body: UPI or card, before you buy materials.

items.title: A waitlist that offers seats
items.body: In order, with a time limit.

items.title: What to bring, on the booking
items.body: Where, when and what to bring, in one place.

items.title: Early-bird pricing
items.body: The price can step up as seats fill.

sections.title: of ticket sales, never more than ₹10,000 a month.
sections.trial: Free for 30 days from your first workshop, 90 for founding hosts. Payment gateway fees are separate.

examples.title: Eight workshops in a month
examples.body: 5% would be ₹12,000; the cap stops it at ₹10,000.

items.question: Can I ask guests questions before they come?
items.answer: Yes. Add your questions to the event, and the answers are on each guest’s record.

items.question: What happens when someone drops out?
items.answer: Refunds follow your cancellation policy, and the seat is offered to the next person on the waitlist.

items.question: Can regulars book before everyone else?
items.answer: Yes, with a membership: members can book early, pay a member price or have workshops included.

items.question: Can I sell a ticket that includes materials?
items.answer: Yes. Set the price and say what’s included on the page.

items.question: Do guests need an app?
items.answer: No. They book, pay and check in in their phone’s browser.

items.question: Can I bring my list from Instagram DMs or a sheet?
items.answer: Yes. Import a CSV or Excel file of past guests before your next workshop.
